data.title: Insurer requests documents for deer-collision claim
data.summary: Kfz-Versicherung Beispielsicher AG asks Bastian Musterquell to send a wildlife damage certificate (Wildschadenbescheinigung) from the hunting lease holder or police, plus the completed claim questionnaire, for the partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) handling of his deer collision claim (Schadennummer KS-26-1109-218, dated 9 November 2026). The documents must be returned within 13 working days of the letter's date, 21 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your car insurer needs proof that the damage was caused by a wild animal (a certificate from the hunting lease holder or the police) plus their claim questionnaire before they can process your comprehensive insurance (Teilkasko) claim for the deer collision. Fill in the enclosed questionnaire and get the certificate, then send both back to the insurer by the deadline shown by the app, which is counted in working days (Monday–Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the letter's date. The letter does not say what happens if you miss it, but delaying could slow down or jeopardise your claim, so it's best to act promptly.
